purpose: Last bounded reference supplement only; no new algorithm, thresholds or old-panel relabeling.

priority: DAVIS real-video sources with explicit media-use permission
CDnet or equivalent real dynamic-background sources with explicit research-media terms
existing licensed public sources only if previously unused contrasts can fill a specified spatial category
sampling.frames: first frame and nearest available frame one second later; use source frame-rate metadata, or first and thirtieth frame when frame rate is absent and disclose index-only sampling
sampling.selection: choose first eligible named sequences in alphabetical order within the needed source categories; freeze identifiers before visual inspection; no replacement on label disagreement or poor visibility

categories.water: visible local ripple, foam or flow difference; whole-scene identity alone is insufficient
categories.foliage: visible leaf/branch displacement; camera shift alone is registration, not foliage
categories.illumination: visible lighting or shadow difference with source objects separately assessed; not automatically nuisance
categories.gesture_or_expression: visible hand/body/face change; distinct action/dish retention is already required by user, only same-action fine progression may need preference
categories.visibility: clear|limited|not_observable; no important/nuisance inference from residual magnitude or category name

annotation: two fresh independent panels; normalized boxes, visibility, importance, directional coverage, confidence, explicit preference; reversed display order; no algorithm outputs; use prior rubric agreement thresholds, preserve all disagreements
stop: stop source search at cumulative 30 minutes, including previous 5-minute allowance
reject sources without clear media-use terms, without bounded retrieval, or beyond remaining bytes
no sample replacement to reach agreement
if real contrasts unavailable or not observable within budget, report failure and end this supplement
U01 pending answer is not a blocker for independent collection and is never inferred
output: source/license/size/visibility ledger, separate reference and preference blockers, optional new blind references, one next research recommendation at most
